manual_notes: Runtime upgrade has extensive implementation: explicit confirmed and locked execution, version/state projection, preview dialog, custom Upgrade snapshots, purge-only Uninstall before SQL/storage cleanup, failure diagnostics and shared publication. A concrete required retry interaction is inconsistent: failure projection returns upgrade_failed before setting UpgradeAvailable, but the management retry button requires upgradeAvailable=true. Thus failed upgrades may have backend retry support without the required management-page action. The same early-return pattern and UI gate occur in inspected May and July revisions. Strict full-scope completion is unresolved, not abandonment.
